title: gemma-tpu-suite variables
description: Configuration variables for the gemma-tpu-suite 7-backend TFRC TPU benchmark component.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_VERSION.description: Version tag of gemma-tpu-suite to install.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_REPO_DIR.description: Filesystem path to the target ML workspace repository (e.g. gemma-4-sql).

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_RESULTS_DIR.description: Local directory where per-cell E0-E4 JSON artifacts and comparison summaries are written.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_MODEL.description: Model identifier passed to Gemma 4 workloads.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_BACKENDS.description: Comma-separated list of backends to evaluate across the TPU matrix.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_SUBSUITES.description: Comma-separated list of sub-suites (E0,E1,E2,E3,E4) to execute.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_WARMUP.description: Number of untimed XLA compilation warm-up runs before timed trials.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_TRIALS.description: Number of measured steady-state trials per workload cell.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_COMMAND_TEMPLATE.description: Optional custom templated command executed across every selected backend in Suite E4.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_REQUIRE_HBM.description: Flag (0 or 1) enforcing fail-fast exit 65 when active TPU HBM or /dev/accel* activity is absent.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_RESUME.description: Flag (0 or 1) skipping already-completed valid cells matching the current workspace tree digest.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_LOCAL_EXEC.description: Flag (0 or 1) executing suite workloads in local/worker mode rather than dispatching over gcloud SSH.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_SHM_ROOT.description: Root tmpfs directory used for isolated per-backend uv virtualenvs and shared model caches.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_SYNTHETIC_FIXTURES.description: Internal CI flag (0 or 1) enabling hermetic synthetic probe/telemetry fixtures during offline testing.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_DRY_RUN.description: Flag (0 or 1) validating configuration and logging planned actions without running workloads.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_SKIP_CUSTOM_EXEC.description: Internal flag (0 or 1) synthesizing comparison_summary artifacts without re-executing custom E4 templates locally after remote execution.

GEMMA_TPU_SUITE_ENABLED.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether gemma-tpu-suite is enabled in an execution plan.
